placement.claim: A proposal-review coordination capability is the immediate candidate, but evidence has not resolved whether selection and synthesis share one owner or whether the capability belongs to a shared cross-phase review substrate.

reopening_conditions: Dogfooding shows that panel selection and synthesis require different independence, information, or durable-state lifetimes.
A specialist registry needs mechanically governed capability metadata rather than an open judgment surface.
Implementation review establishes a primary shared consumer whose boundary conflicts with proposal-local coordination.
Deterministic evidence proves sufficient for representative proposals without model specialist review.
A real revision shows that the proposed readiness projection, advisory applicability assessment, downstream reliance judgment, and authority decision cannot remain truthfully distinct.
A selected review episode produces a material finding that the proposed complete-disposition contract cannot preserve without making synthesis mechanically procedural.

authority.decision_owner: user or future explicitly authorized portfolio owner

relationships.rationale: Adaptive panel coordination needs the review-artifact profile so specialist episodes, findings, conflicts, truthful outcomes, synthesis references, and later applicability retain exact identity and non-authoritative status.
